items.text: Final report: Pittsburgh ruled out CB Brandin Echols (hamstring) and WR Ben Skowronek (calf); RB Rico Dowdle (knee) and S DeShon Elliott (knee) are questionable. T.J. Watt (calf) is expected to play. WRs Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson are on IR; Aaron Rodgers starts.
Final report: New Orleans lists only G Cesar Ruiz (knee) and DT Nathan Shepherd (illness) as questionable; Tyler Shough starts. Game is in Paris (9:30 a.m. ET).
